children: Shell's results show the business is extremely well-suited to take advantage of disruptions across the energy complex, RBC Capital Markets analyst Biraj Borkhataria writes. Even with the British energy major launching a $5 billion buyback Thursday, it will likely miss its full-year payout ratio guidance, he says. However, this reflects a macroeconomic environment that is far from normal, he adds. There is a potential for distributions to be rebalanced toward dividends at the next strategy update, he says. Shares rise 3.3% to 4,089 pence. (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
